text:
Sam R: Uploading red-team artifacts for the ACME POC to the shared bucket. Bundle: s3://redwood-pt-sharing/acme-poc/redteam-20260315.tar.gz. Included: full pen-test report, repro scripts, findings.csv, and raw pcap. MD5: `d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e`
Priya T: thanks. can you confirm which findings are client-visible vs infra-only? need to prep the customer summary.
Sam R: yes — findings.csv has a `visibility` column. Quick breakdown: 3 critical (customer-impacting), 4 high (config + infra), rest medium/low.
Marco V: repro steps are in `repro/README.md` inside the tar. I also added a small script to reproduce one of the high severity misconfigs: `./repro/run_high_01.sh`.
Lena K: legal asked for a signed statement that no customer data was exfiltrated during testing. Sam, can you drop a short note confirming that?
Sam R: confirmed — red team ran on synthetic tenant with scrubbed logs. No customer data touched. Will add signed note to S3 in `evidence/statement-signed.pdf`.
security-bot: Automated external scan completed for bundle s3://redwood-pt-sharing/acme-poc/redteam-20260315.tar.gz — Summary: 14 findings total (3 CRITICAL, 4 HIGH, 5 MEDIUM, 2 LOW). CVE link: https://vuln.example/reports/ACME-2026-03. Details uploaded to the `scan-results/` folder.
Priya T: customer asked about remediation owners and ETA for retest. What are we committing to?
Marco V: owners: infra-team for the 4 infra-related, app-team for 3 customer-impacting. Proposed remediation ETA: 2 weeks for high, 4 weeks for critical with staged mitigations.
Sam R: proposed timeline and owners added to `remediation_plan.md` in the bundle. Short version:
```
- Critical (3): mitigation window 28 days, owner @app-team, weekly checkpoints
- High (4): fix window 14 days, owner @infra-team, verify in 10 days
- Medium/Low: backlog grooming, standard sprint tickets
```
Priya T: can we commit a retest date to ACME? they'd like hard dates for procurement/legal signoff.
Lena K: legal prefers retest to be within 45 days of report, otherwise they want a risk acceptance.
Sam R: suggest we offer retest window between 2026-04-12 and 2026-04-16 (gives teams 3 weeks). If legal pushes, we can extend but that'll require risk acceptance.
Priya T: OK I'll propose that to the customer. Can you also attach checksums and a quick verification command they can run?
Sam R: added verification snippet to S3 README: `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-pt-sharing/acme-poc/redteam-20260315.tar.gz - | md5sum -c -` and the public checksum file at `s3://redwood-pt-sharing/acme-poc/sha256sums.txt` (sha256: `e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855`).
Marco V: also added a minimal CSV mapping `finding_id -> remediation_ticket` for the customer to follow along.
security-bot: Note: do not expose the `raw-pcap/` folder to customer link. It's in the bundle but access is restricted. Audit log: `s3:GetObject` denied for external-acme-role at 2026-03-15T16:02:11Z.
Priya T: perfect. I'll send the customer the bundle link + short exec summary + proposed retest window. Will loop back once they confirm dates. :thumbsup:
Lena K: I'll draft the legal attestation and add a note re: export controls.
Sam R: thanks all — owners please add sprint tickets for your fixes and tag `acme-poc-pt` so I can track.
Priya T: quick Q — do we want to offer a limited shared remediation call with their security team next week? might speed signoff.
Marco V: yes, 30min walkthrough with app+infra owners. I'm available Tue/Wed mornings.
Priya T: scheduled provisional 30min call: Tue 2026-03-23 10:00 PT. I'll update the calendar and include the remediation_plan.md.
Sam R: noted. I'll upload the signed statement and final checksums by EOD. :white_check_mark:
